instructions: Get T-number (task number) from .TODO/config.json before adding new numbered tasks. Assign a T- prefixed task number to every task in todo-next.md, todo-done.md, todo-future.md, and todo-ignore.md. Keep todo-next.md as the only active queue. Move completed tasks to todo-done.md, deferred tasks to todo-future.md, and deliberate no-fix decisions to todo-ignore.md. Do not duplicate tasks that already exist in todo-next.md.
suggestions: Keep TODO-next focused on important developer and end-user work.
Use shared config under data-config/frontend_shared.json and data-config/server.json for the date/alias rule source.
Document relative date calculation rules and deterministic overwriteToday behaviour.
